test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36 and 46, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2)?
solution:
**Given:**

If x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36, and 46, the numbers would in proportion. 

**Concepts used:**

Componendo and Dividendo

If p:q :: r:s, then 

Componendo

⇒ (p + q)/q = (r + s)/s

Dividendo

⇒ (p - q)/p = (r - s)/s

Mean Proportional between two numbers a and b = √ab

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

(24 - x)/(30 - x) = (36 - x)/(46 - x)

Using Componendo and Dividendo

⇒ (24 - x + 30 - x)/(24 - x - 30 + x) = (36 - x + 46 - x)/(36 - x - 46 + x)

⇒ (54 - 2x)/(- 6) = (82 - 2x)/(-10) 

⇒ (27 - x)/3 = (41 - x)/5

⇒ 5(27 - x) = 3(41 - x)

⇒ 135 - 5x = 123 - 3x 

⇒ 12 = 2x

⇒ x = 6

**∴ Mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2) = √(2x + 3)(3x + 2)**

⇒ √(2 × 6 + 3)(3 × 6 + 2)

⇒ √300 

⇒ 10√3
